denoms.description: The denoms of the pair. The second denom is the quote denom

fee_address.description: The destination address for fees collected

fee_maker.description: The fee charged on withdrawals from filled limit orders

fee_taker.description: The fee charged on swaps, and instantly filled limit orders

market_maker.description: The address of the market maker contract. Must implement [crate::market_maker::MarketMakerQuery], and return funds with [CallbackMsg::MarketMaker]

tick.description: Ticked truncates Decimal to significant figures. This accommodates prices decreasing and adding zeroes, but may need adjusting for better UX as prices increase (e.g. 4sf is plenty for most tokens < $10 - 1 cent, but above $1000 it creates a $1 tick)

Decimal.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 (which is (2^128 - 1) / 10^18)
